name: SEAL
recent: SEAL 于 2026 年 10 月 21 日召开 EGM，通过向 24.55% 联营公司 MSR Green Energy 提供额外财务援助（企业担保）的议案；10 月 19 日宣布与 Titanium Greenview 的战略合作条件截止日延长至 2027 年 1 月 31 日。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日召开第 64 届 AGM，最新 1QFY2027 业绩显示营收下降 14.98%，但税前利润因联营公司贡献而上升。
notable: EGM 通过向 24.55% 联营公司 MSR Green Energy 提供额外财务援助（企业担保）的议案。
与 Titanium Greenview 的战略合作（TGSB 认购 Mutiara Waterfront Habitats 新股至 82.34%）条件截止日延长至 2027 年 1 月 31 日。
risks: 公司为联营公司 MSR Green Energy 的银行融资及外汇合约提供企业担保，承担或有负债。
战略合作的条件截止日已多次延长，交易尚未完成。

recent_en: SEAL held an EGM on 21 Oct 2026 where shareholders approved additional financial assistance (corporate guarantee) to its 24.55%-owned associate MSR Green Energy. On 19 Oct 2026, the company announced an extension of the conditions precedent deadline for its strategic collaboration with Titanium Greenview to 31 Jan 2027. Latest 1QFY2027 results showed revenue down 14.98% but pre-tax profit higher on associate contribution.
notable_en: EGM approved additional financial assistance (corporate guarantee) to 24.55%-owned associate MSR Green Energy.
Conditions precedent deadline for strategic collaboration with Titanium Greenview (TGSB subscribing new shares for 82.34% of Mutiara Waterfront Habitats) extended to 31 Jan 2027.
risks_en: Company provides corporate guarantee for associate MSR Green Energy's banking and FX facilities, creating contingent liabilities.
Conditions precedent deadline for the strategic collaboration has been extended multiple times; the transaction is not yet completed.
